title: Recover P by STNFS on a directly sampled region: 121.400000

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the complete STNFS algorithm of proof.md and DESCENT.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q (P = infinity for z = 1), with success at least 0.392624 (hence at least 0.39) under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5. It maps g = e(P0,Q) and z into the core tower by an explicit field isomorphism, computes two GT logarithms against one relation and linear-algebra phase, and returns P = [a]P0 after checking e(P,Q) = z. Relation collection is on the theta = 2/5 region, sampled directly by a 32,000-draw pool (3,907 canonical rows), with a 1.0334 canonical-work allowance (2.00 SE): <= 2^121.2492 units at a 0.4766-bit relation margin. Linear algebra <= 2^117.5157, generator <= 2^107.1997, two-log meter 2^116.3915 (expected <= 2^115.6681). All classical work, including preprocessing, failures, field conversion, pairings, verification and output, is bounded by a global meter at 2^121.400000 dense-Fp12 units (C = 20,000 instructions); the upper-rounded ledger rows sum to less than that. Nothing is amortized; no advice. Memory at most 2^105 bytes. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Bounded audit: code hashes, quadrature parameters and integration controls, and the upward-rounded ledger and success from refinement.json. Does not rerun the full recurrence.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py) to mean weight 100 and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.88) and U/N. Optional (the hosted initial run is the bounded audit). Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
Optional full recomputation of pool, region, yield, ledger, filtering, retention, ECM, descent and declared bounds (about 10 s natively).
